scope: Genuine coupled staggered PDAS re-equilibration execution on non-coarsened C6 mesh (15,252 CPE4 quads, 15,559 physical nodes) at target uy = 0.0018703125 mm using convex damage under-relaxation (omega_d = 0.5) to collapse crack-tip limit cycle. Authorized for exactly 1 PBS submission; serial 1 CPU, 16 GB, 8 h.
scientific_hypothesis: Package 171-R1 exhibited a period-2 alternating limit-cycle instability at Outer 100 (delta_d ~ 7.17e-3, delta_u ~ 4.51e-5 mm, delta_h ~ 271.5 MPa) due to crack-tip strain-damage feedback with negative eigenvalue lambda = -1.0. Convex damage under-relaxation with omega_d = 0.5 deadbeat-collapses the limit cycle (lambda_damped = 0.0) and contracts the coupled spectrum to rho <= 0.875 while strictly preserving d >= d0, d <= 1.0, discrete KKT complementarity, and non-accumulating history.

mathematical_formulation.obstacle_enforcement: Pointwise active-set Dirichlet clamp prescribed = {n: d0[n] for n in active} ensuring min(d - d0) >= -1.0e-6
